case_name: Smt. Shobha D/O Gulappa Tirlapur W/O S ... vs Shri. S Manohara S/O Shiuvaraju

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Shobha D/O Gulappa Tirlapur W/O S, wife and home maker
parties.respondent_defendant: Shri. S Manohara S/O Shiuvaraju, husband and forest department guard

facts_of_case: Marriage between parties was solemnized on 13.11.2009. Parties have resided together and a son is born to them from the said wedlock. Petitioner seeks transfer of G & WC No.9/2023 pending on the file of Senior Civil Judge and CJM, Mandya to the Prl. Judge, Family Court, Hubballi.

legal_principles.principle: The court may transfer a case to another court in the interest of justice and equity.
legal_principles.held: This Court made the following order: The present petition is filed by the wife under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 seeking for transfer of G & WC No.9/2023 pending on the file of the Senior Civil Judge and CJM, Mandya to the Prl. Judge, Family Court, Hubballi.

legal_principles.principle: A court may consider the interest of justice and equity while transferring a case.
legal_principles.held: The Court made the following order: ... in the interest of justice and equity.

outcome.final_order: The present petition is allowed and the G & WC No.9/2023 pending on the file of Senior Civil Judge and CJM, Mandya is transferred to the Prl. Judge, Family Court, Hubballi.
